title: Grafana SSO with Casdoor: OpenID Connect Setup
headline: Single sign-on for Grafana
summary: Grafana's Generic OAuth works with any OpenID Connect provider. Point it at Casdoor and people sign in to Grafana with their Casdoor accounts, MFA and social logins included, with their Grafana role set from Casdoor groups.

steps.title: Configure Grafana
steps.text: Add this section to `grafana.ini`, or set the same keys as `GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_*` environment variables. `root_url` must be the address people open in the browser, because Grafana builds the callback URL from it.

code.content:
[server]
root_url = {{appUrl}}/

[auth.generic_oauth]
enabled = true
name = Casdoor
client_id = {{clientId}}
client_secret = {{clientSecret}}
scopes = openid profile email
auth_url = {{casdoorUrl}}/login/oauth/authorize
token_url = {{casdoorUrl}}/api/login/oauth/access_token
api_url = {{casdoorUrl}}/api/userinfo
use_pkce = true
allow_sign_up = true
login_attribute_path = preferred_username
email_attribute_path = email
groups_attribute_path = groups
role_attribute_path = contains(groups[*], 'grafana-admins') && 'Admin' || contains(groups[*], 'grafana-editors') && 'Editor' || 'Viewer'

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Restart Grafana. The login page now has a **Sign in with Casdoor** button. Members of `grafana-admins` become Admins, members of `grafana-editors` Editors, and everyone else a Viewer.

tips: Grafana evaluates `role_attribute_path` against the ID token first, then the userinfo response. Casdoor's ID token also lists the user's roles as objects, so `contains(roles[*].name, 'admin')` works too if you prefer Casdoor roles to groups.
Grafana needs an email address for every user, so make sure your Casdoor users have one.

faqs.question: Can I use SAML instead?
faqs.answer: Grafana's SAML sign-in is part of Grafana Enterprise and Grafana Cloud. On open-source Grafana, OpenID Connect through Generic OAuth, as shown here, is the way to connect Casdoor.

faqs.question: Do Casdoor groups become Grafana teams?
faqs.answer: `groups_attribute_path` feeds Grafana's Team Sync, which is a Grafana Enterprise and Grafana Cloud feature. On open-source Grafana, use the groups to set roles as shown above.
